eventDetail.scope: The scope of (AECE-2025) is to provide an international forum to promote, enhance and stimulate international research interactions and collaboration in the fields of Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Healthcare and Information Technology. It will facilitate to promote the exchange of ideas among interested researchers, students, industrialists, developers and practitioners. This conference will also feature plenary talks, workshops, and parallel technical sessions.
